name: Nandan Pandey
title: Backend Engineer
tagline: Building scalable, reliable backend systems and real-time services.
about: I’m a backend-focused software engineer with 5+ years of experience building production applications and backend systems. My work has ranged from React Native applications and Node.js backends to real-time gaming services and Go-based cybersecurity integrations.

I enjoy working on APIs, data systems, real-time communication, cloud services, and the engineering problems that make systems reliable and performant. My current work focuses primarily on TypeScript/Node.js, AWS, and cybersecurity integrations, with additional experience contributing to Go-based agent and inspector functionality.
availability: Open to backend engineering opportunities, especially roles involving Go, Node.js, distributed systems, real-time services, and performance-focused engineering.
